issues.description: The Problem Statement and the Template define Developer.monthsOfSwiftExperience as Int? (an optional Int), but the Solution implements monthsOfSwiftExperience as Double?. This type mismatch across artifacts is structural (attribute type inconsistency) and can confuse students about the expected type and how to implement optional binding and switch comparisons (the spec expects integer months, e.g. equality to 1).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type of monthsOfSwiftExperience consistent across artifacts. Preferably change the Solution implementation to use Int? for monthsOfSwiftExperience (instead of Double?) so it matches the Problem Statement and Template, and update any related logic accordingly (optional binding and switch on Int).
